proposed_memory.lesson: Carefully consider all given clues and evaluator feedback to determine the single intended answer; avoid switching back and forth between candidates without new justification.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: Analyze the clues and evaluation hints thoroughly before submitting one final choice without contradiction or repeated switching.
proposed_memory.observed_problem: Persistent failure to identify the evaluator's preferred single intended answer despite following instructions to switch between HFL and HLF.
